Join our innovative healthcare team as a Coding Director and lead the charge in physician coding compliance, audits, and revenue integrity across our enterprise. This dynamic role offers an exciting opportunity for a seasoned professional to shape coding strategies, lead cross-functional teams, and drive operational excellence—all in a remote setting. If you’re passionate about advancing coding standards and improving healthcare outcomes, we want to hear from you!

Required Skills:

  • Seven or more years of progressive professional coding, coding compliance, auditing, provider education, or revenue integrity experience
  • Three or more years of leadership experience managing staff performance, workload, quality, and operational outcomes
  • Hands-on experience with athenaOne platform
  • Proven expertise in managing CMS, payer, provider, or enterprise coding audits and implementing corrective actions
  • Experience implementing coding, audit, workflow, analytics, or automation technology
  • Strong knowledge of nephrology, dialysis, and ESRD professional coding (strongly preferred)
  • Leadership of onshore and offshore teams or external vendors (strongly preferred)

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience managing external coding or audit vendors
  • Familiarity with implementing healthcare technology solutions and analytics tools

CSI Companies is looking to add experienced Epic Go-Live Support Consultants to join our growing team. As an Epic Go-Live Support consultant, you’ll provide guidance to physicians, nurses, and other clinical and non-clinical users as our client’s new EMR system is activated. For our client’s users, you will be providing immediate at the elbow Epic system support as they take on patient care within their healthcare system, providing you the opportunity to build the end user’s confidence as they transition to Epic and assist them in positively impacting patient care. This year will be a great time to jump into a contract ATE position as CSI has several awarded projects lined up in October and November 2026 with potential to continue from contract to contract into 2027. These projects are located throughout the United States.

 

Role Description –

  • Review necessary Client-specific materials made available
  • Participate in orientation training specific to Client’s environment
  • Assist front desk staff, clinicians, and physicians in the use of the Epic software
  • Identify and document any issues with such software
  • Provide high-priority responses to critical issues
  • Document-level of clinical satisfaction and adoption as directed by Client
 

Experience – Previous Epic ATE support strongly preferred
 

Travel

SAP Business Systems Analyst (SAP CS/SM/OTC) - Remote

Location: Remote with occasional travel to Nashville, TN
Position Type: W2 Contract
Compensation: Competitive hourly rate based on experience

CSI Companies is seeking an experienced SAP Business Systems Analyst to support a large-scale enterprise environment focused on Customer Service and Service Management operations. This role will partner with business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership to optimize SAP solutions, improve business processes, and support strategic initiatives across service operations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes, along with strong business analysis, requirements gathering, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to SAP Customer Service, Service Management, and Order-to-Cash processes.
  • Serve as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into effective SAP solutions.
  • Support and enhance SAP CS and SM functionality, including service contracts, service orders, warranties, repairs, and field service operations.
